At 3 mm every design scores 150-165, so the 2 mm line sits on a cliff where one clip pose = 1.18 points. vs frontload: plain +3.59, 1 mm +4.14, held out plain +4.62; the reason text 'the gain is metal moved into the 1-2 mm shell' is contradicted by the auditor's own probe (docs/alignment/live_audit_2026-10-16/probe_*.json): the sidecar gain over frontload is the rod drive's far metal (samples > 20 mm 8.3 % -> 2.8 %, workspace in-band 0.827 -> 0.870/0.874, frontload rod 0 % in band at a median 22 mm). More grazing poses comes with a real gain: a trade-off for the wearer ('watch'), not a fake improvement ('gamed'). The 2 mm comparison itself rests on the unadopted 2 mm threshold.
